samples.claim: project_by_schema accepts S:TryInto<Self,Error=Error>, converts once, iterates projection order, rejects any requested root name containing a dot, then resolves matching Self fields and calls project_by_field with the supplied mismatch mode. OnMissing::Error yields a Schema error for missing roots; Ignore drops them. Result preserves Self metadata. A &Schema conversion later clones without validation, while &ArrowSchema conversion assigns IDs/validates/verifies keys; generic input type therefore affects preliminary checks (rust/lance-core/src/datatypes/schema.rs:889-928).
samples.review_note: Matches projection ordering, dot rejection, missing policy and metadata. Supplemental schema.rs889-928 confirms differing Arrow and borrowed-Schema conversion checks.

samples.claim: test_str_to_bool_falsy loops over ten 0/false/off/no/n case variants and checks Some(false). These tests establish source intent for accepted negative words rather than treating any unknown as an explicit false token.
samples.review_note: Matches ten explicit negative tokens and Some(false) assertion; unknown input is not asserted here.

samples.claim: Default remap_row_ids(&self,&[u64])->Result<Vec<Option<u64>>> reserves input length, iterates in input order and sequentially awaits remap_row_id, pushing one result per input. Duplicates and None positions are preserved, empty input gives empty Vec, and the first Err stops iteration and discards the partial result. There is no concurrent buffering or aggregation. Cancellation can interrupt an in-flight single-row future; the trait makes no rollback promise for implementation side effects.
samples.review_note: Matches one sequential await per input, ordered output, duplicates and fail-fast Result propagation; no side-effect rollback contract.

samples.claim: Ready(None) marks exhausted and clears polling. Ready(Some(item)) also clears polling, then checks whether the opposite side is alive: if alive, forget the acquired permit, increment the peer's u32 counter and enqueue item.clone(); if dropped, skip clone/counter/queue and let the permit release normally. The original item goes directly to the polling side. A clone panic happens while holding the state mutex after permit/counter updates, so poisoning/recovery is not handled here. Unbounded queued counts still use u32, so capacity-independent integer overflow is possible at extreme backlog; no runtime reproduction is claimed. Lock reacquisition before the match and returning the original poll result are at rust/lance-core/src/utils/futures.rs:184-195 and rust/lance-core/src/utils/futures.rs:225-246.
samples.review_note: Matches permit forgetting, peer count, conditional clone and original return. Supplemental futures.rs34-35,160-196,225-246 confirms u32 counters and mutex reacquisition/unwrap; panic/overflow edges remain source deductions.

samples.claim: Field.Type distinguishes PARENT=0, REPEATED=1, LEAF=2. Fields are Type type=1, fully qualified name string=2, signed id=3, and signed parent_id=4. ID assignment refers to DataFile.fields. The parent comment says not-set means top-level, but parent_id is a bare proto3 int32 without presence; the actual sentinel/default convention must come from conversion code. Do not assume Option semantics.
samples.review_note: Matches enum numbers, field tags and signed IDs; bare parent_id has no optional presence.

samples.claim: List and LargeList downcast with unwrap, obtain row child array then recursively extract each element in order. Any null/unsupported child aborts entire key. Empty list yields Some(List(empty)); both list widths share representation. Capacity preallocated to child length; arbitrary nesting may recurse and allocate repeatedly. FixedSizeList is not handled.
samples.review_note: Matches both recursive list branches. Supplemental key_existence.rs373-390 confirms remaining Struct and default None branches, excluding FixedSizeList.

samples.claim: test_backtrace_captured_when_feature_enabled comments require RUST_BACKTRACE=1 before process startup because capture checks may cache. Actual enabled assertion runs whenever std::env::var(RUST_BACKTRACE).is_ok(), not only when value equals 1, so comment and predicate differ for values such as 0 or empty. If unset it makes no capture assertion. Feature-disabled branch asserts None. No environment is changed by the test itself.
samples.review_note: Matches feature gates and actual environment-presence predicate; comment mismatch is accurately scoped, with no runtime result claimed.

samples.claim: schema nested project_field treats blob/packed struct as atomic: clone entire field only if its own ID is mapped. Otherwise recursively projects children; any surviving children retain a cloned parent even if parent ID is absent. A leaf survives only if mapped. With no surviving children, V2.0 alone retains a mapped structural parent with empty children, preserving its physical header. Comments explain evolved child IDs must not be substituted from current schema; actual null filling belongs to a reader outside this file.
samples.review_note: Matches atomic blob/packed handling, recursively surviving children and V2.0 empty structural parent; null fill is delegated.

samples.claim: first_row(fragment_id:u32)->Self delegates to new_from_parts(fragment_id,0). address_range(fragment_id:u32)->Range<u64> returns first_row(fragment)..first_row(fragment+1), half-open. The doctest checks boundaries for fragment 2. Addition fragment_id+1 has no checked_add/guard; callers must avoid u32::MAX, whose next fragment is unrepresentable and may panic with overflow checking or wrap without it. This is a source-derived edge case, not an executed test result.
samples.review_note: Matches first-row delegation, half-open range and unchecked next-fragment addition; edge case explicitly source-derived.
